readme:
# Milkround UK Graduate Jobs Scraper

Scrape UK graduate jobs, schemes, internships and placements from [Milkround.com](https://www.milkround.com), the UK's dedicated graduate recruitment platform. Paste a search URL or a keyword and location; get every listing back as structured JSON with employer, salary, scheme type, sector, degree required, start date type and closing date.

## What it does

Pulls live UK graduate vacancies from Milkround.com search results, deduplicates them, and pushes them to your Apify dataset. Handles pagination automatically up to your result cap. Optionally opens each job's detail page for structured salary ranges, ISO closing dates, and full descriptions.

Fields you get per job:
- Job title, employer name, employer logo
- Location, country, salary (min, max, currency, period)
- Employment type (graduate-scheme, graduate-job, internship, placement-year, apprenticeship)
- Workplace type (on-site, hybrid, remote)
- Sector (Technology, Finance, Consulting, Engineering, Law, Marketing, etc.)
- Degree required (any, 2:2, 2:1, 1st, masters, phd)
- Start date type (immediate, september-intake, rolling)
- Duration in months (for placements and internships)
- Scheme size (number of graduate positions, where disclosed)
- Closing date, posted date
- Direct application URL

## Pricing

Pay-per-event, so you only pay for what you use.

| Event | Rate |
|---|---:|
| Actor start | $0.001 per run |
| Job from search page | $0.003 per job |
| Job with detail-page enrichment | $0.005 per job |
| Company profile (unique employer, when `includeCompanyDetails=true`) | $0.005 per employer |

**New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough for around 1,000 enriched graduate jobs on this actor before you commit to paying anything. Test extensively first.

## Input

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `searchUrls` | array | Copy any Milkround.com search URL. Filters preserved. |
| `searchQueries` | array | Keyword queries (for example `software engineer`, `marketing graduate`, `finance internship`). |
| `location` | string | UK city, county or postcode. Applied to keyword queries. |
| `maxResults` | integer | Total cap across all queries. |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | Cap per individual query. |
| `includeJobDetails` | boolean | Open each detail page for structured salary and full description. |
| `includeCompanyDetails` | boolean | Also fetch each unique employer profile page (About, phone, address, website, other open roles). Deduplicated per employer. Implies `includeJobDetails=true`. |
| `maxConcurrency` | integer | Concurrent detail requests (1 to 20). |

## Output fields

Every dataset row has a stable schema documented in the Output tab. Key derived fields:

- `employment_type`: graduate-scheme, graduate-job, internship, placement-year, apprenticeship
- `workplace_type`: on-site, hybrid, remote
- `sector`: Technology, Finance, Consulting, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Law, Retail, Media, Healthcare, Public Sector, Energy, Property, Human Resources
- `degree_required`: any, 2:2, 2:1, 1st, masters, phd
- `start_date_type`: immediate, september-intake, rolling
- `duration_months`: parsed from placement and internship copy (e.g. 6, 12)
- `scheme_size`: number of graduate positions when disclosed in ad copy
- `salary_range`: object with `min`, `max`, `currency`, `period`

**Employer profile (populated when `includeCompanyDetails=true`)**

- `company_about`: About-us copy from the employer's profile page
- `company_phone`, `company_email`, `company_website`: Contact details when the employer publishes them
- `company_address_street`, `company_address_city`, `company_address_postcode`, `company_address_country`: Employer postal address
- `company_active_jobs_count`: Total other open roles at the same employer
- `company_active_jobs`: Snapshot of other open roles (title, location, salary, snippet)

## Use with an AI agent (MCP)

Connect this actor to Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client to have your agent pull UK graduate opportunities on demand.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "milkround-uk-scraper": {
      "url": "https://mcp.apify.com/?actors=santamaria-automations/milkround-uk-scraper"
    }
  }
}
```

Example prompt: "Find 30 finance internships in London on Milkround starting summer 2027, and return the employer, salary and closing date."

## Why this scraper

Built HTTP-only in Go for consistent speed and low cost. Uses schema.org JobPosting data on detail pages, so structured salary and closing dates come straight from the source markup. Derives graduate-specific fields (scheme type, degree class, placement duration) from title and ad copy using UK graduate-recruitment vocabulary (spring week, insight week, sandwich placement, 2:1, cohort size).

## Common use cases

- Graduate recruitment agencies tracking new schemes daily
- University careers services benchmarking employers and salary bands
- Ed-tech vendors building account lists of UK graduate employers
- Student societies aggregating opportunities for their members
- Research teams studying UK graduate labour market trends

## Notes and limits

- **URL note**: Milkround.com and Totaljobs.com share the same backend inventory (both are Totaljobs Group brands). Milkround does NOT serve individual PDP URLs of its own: all SERP anchors resolve to totaljobs.com. This scraper emits the totaljobs.com URL in `job_url` because that is the only URL where the job page actually lives. `application_url` is emitted as null (there is no separate apply URL: users apply on the totaljobs.com page itself).
- When `includeCompanyDetails=true`, each unique employer is fetched once per run (deduplicated by employer URL). Milkround PDPs live on totaljobs.com so the employer page is fetched from that domain when a link is present in the JSON-LD. Fill rates vary because totaljobs uses different templates per employer tier.

- Coverage: UK graduate jobs, schemes, internships, placements and apprenticeships listed on Milkround.com
- Salary is often listed as "Competitive" on graduate schemes; that carries through as a null salary range
- `scheme_size` is only populated when the employer explicitly names a cohort size in the ad copy
- `degree_required` defaults to null when the ad doesn't specify a grade requirement
- Milkround covers UK-based opportunities almost exclusively; international rotational schemes appear occasionally
